dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: By the way, something strange happened a few days ago.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: A merchant approached me and requested that I cover the cost of a "Desert Travel Kit." One million, two hundred and fifty thousand Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: I didn't remember owing anyone Mora, especially not that kind of amount. So I arrested the merchant on charges of provocation and disturbing the peace.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Do you know anything about this?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, no—nope... Paimon has no idea what that could be!
